reviews.text: I took my French Bulldogs and it was a super good experience, my little ones were very happy 😍🥰 Thank you 🫂
Excellent place, they treat my pet very well, they always share videos of what they do, and judging by my dog's attitude, it seems like he enjoys it.
I would definitely take my pets to that place; excellent service and they were very attentive to the videos and photos of my pet.
Excellent place for furry friends, I highly recommend it 🫶

Edit: This dog boarding facility doesn't seem to grasp the responsibility of caring for an animal. They want to dismiss our complaint as "false," so I'm including pictures that prove my point.

I left my dog ​​there twice, and both times he came back injured, the second time much more seriously. The dogs are supposed to be supervised to prevent incidents between them, but the condition in which they returned my pet assures me that this isn't the case. Leaving my dog ​​at a kennel and then having to pay 5,000-7,000 pesos for vet bills and treatment doesn't add up. It's good that other people have had positive experiences with this place, but communication is inadequate when incidents occur. Unfortunately, my experience was not positive at all.
Excellent attention and care for pets, a service definitely highly recommended.

It's our safe and trusted place. Diana is excellent! My dog ​​Bimbo is completely happy with her and under her care. I always feel safe leaving him with her, whether at boarding or doggy daycare; I've only had good experiences.

It's great! My dogs get so excited when they arrive and leave so happy! And they get the same attention they would at home! Ideal for those vacation days when you can't take them or any day you'll be out all day.

My two Norbertos feel right at home. I bring my two dogs, who have very different personalities, and they're very well cared for. Diana really goes out of her way to make them feel welcome. She makes it seem like she's made the dogs her own too.
I feel completely confident leaving my puppies in Diana's care. She's an excellent person who cares deeply and takes excellent care of them.
The best option in the entire city to leave your dogs
Very kind treatment to both dogs and humans 😁 You can trust that everything will be in order …

For the past year, whenever I go out, I leave Kibo in their care, knowing he'll be pampered, safe, and have a great time playing with other dogs.

I love that they send me photos and videos every day to let me know how my little guy is doing.

They even help me when I have a special request, like giving him some medication.

My dog ​​Atún always has a great time at Paws N Tails. She has a large garden and can socialize with other dogs, always under supervision. I love that they send me a daily video showing how she's doing and how well she's settling in.
Excellent service, a garden large enough for the dogs to walk and socialize.

Excellent place for dogs! They offer personalized attention, professional training, and spacious, well-maintained facilities in a central location with easy access. We were looking for a place like this where our dog could create wonderful memories. Every time we take her, she happily goes inside. During her stay, they send us messages with photos of how her day is going. The prices are very reasonable. There's both open and covered space available.
They explain their procedures to you.
They ask about your dog's food needs and follow them perfectly, whether you bring them natural food or kibble. They also have a wide variety of options available.
Most importantly, there are no cages, which is a huge plus. 5 stars

Highly recommended service!
My dogs are happy and well cared for!
Excellent attention and care for my pet, as if she were at home. She comes back very happy every time she's at Paws N Tails.

Highly recommended!!
We are so happy with the daycare, as they treat the dogs with so much love and care. They are very responsible and always keep us informed, which gives us great peace of mind. As owners, we are happy to be able to go for walks or trips knowing that our dog is in a safe place, where he is cared for like he's at home.
We highly recommend this place and sincerely thank them for all the love and attention they give Tommy ❤️🐶

After searching many places, I found the best one!! Diana showers them with love, teaches them to respect plants and other animals, and makes them more than just a daycare; it's an extension of home where they can feel right at home. This is thanks to her attention, experience, and knowledge, as she's constantly taking courses. Because, believe it or not, you need to know how to interpret a dog's personality for a healthy coexistence, and you'll find that here. Personalized attention and flexible hours that fit around busy work schedules. In short, thank you for all your hard work and effort; I applaud you, Diana V.

We are absolutely delighted with the service and care that Diana provided to our little ones. Leaving a family member isn't always easy, but with Diana, peace of mind and confidence were immediate.

Her professionalism shines through in our daily communication. We received videos and photos constantly, keeping us informed about their walks, playtime, feeding, and behavior. This allowed us to be completely relaxed during our absence.

Furthermore, she encourages socialization among these little ones, which is incredibly beneficial for them.
It's the only place I trust to leave my girls when I go out. It's a great place, spacious, they can socialize and cool off, and I have complete faith that they'll be in good hands. Thank you, Diana.
My dog ​​has always been very happy at Paws and Tails. The service is flexible with scheduling (because emergencies happen) and you receive photos of your pet for peace of mind.

I've been leaving Genaro with Diana for a couple of years now when I travel. He's very sensitive to lightning and rockets, but Diana always knows how to calm him down and make him feel safe. Since he's been with her, he doesn't get sick anymore, either during his trip or when he gets back home. She always keeps me updated with photos and videos, so I can travel with peace of mind knowing he's in the best hands.
My Felipa and Juanita go to Diana's daycare and spend their days being pampered, sunbathing on the grass. When I pick them up, they're happy and exhausted. Reliable and humane service.

I have a husky, and he would come home exhausted from daycare. He'd collapse on the bus, which is hard to believe given how energetic he is.
He also stayed at a small hotel, and every time we arrived at daycare, he'd howl to go inside. Diana answers all your questions and treats them incredibly well ❤️
Diana is very attentive and careful when Milo visits Paws & Tails. The service is affordable and the facilities are good. 🐾🐶 We recommend it ✌️. …
Excellent dog daycare and a very safe and nice place for our pets 👌👌🙌 …
A perfect place to leave your furry friends. Mine are very happy there.
They're the best, we love them!
